title: Show Me Around tour
description: Steps for the in-app tour. Shared by every platform's renderer (React now, .NET later).

id.description: Unique kebab-case id for the step.

target.description: Value of the element's data-tour attribute. Omit for a centered step.

since.description: Version that introduced the step. Omit for basic-tour steps.

replaces.description: Ids of older what's-new steps this one supersedes. Only this one shows when both would.

route.description: Route to open before the step is shown.
